normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only meaningful within the 3-argument transfer dispatch.
Amount parameter is consumed by the transfer dispatch and forwarding paths.
Data bytes parameter is forwarded by transfer and does not persist state.
Candidate owner argument is written into newOwner inside this function.
Spender argument is only used to index the allowed mapping in approve.
Allowance amount is solely assigned to allowed inside approve.
Source address argument is only used for allowance and balance updates.
Destination address argument is only used for the balance credit.
Amount argument drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
Target token address is only used to build the external ERC20 call.
Amount argument is only passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
Address argument is only inspected via extcodesize within isContract.
Burn amount argument is only used for balance and supply subtraction.
Temporary empty bytes buffer exists only inside the 2-argument transfer.
Temporary code-size value is only used to compute the isContract result.
Cast receiver instance exists only to perform the external doTransfer call.
Price returned by the untrusted external callback controls the balance update.
Owner returned by the untrusted external callback receives credited balances.
Loop counter is strictly local to the bytesToUint parse loop.
Converted byte value is used only inside the bytesToUint loop body.
Accumulator is the subject of the unchecked multiplication and addition.
